scripts.bench-optimized: purs-backend-es --version && spago fetch -p json-codecs-benchmarks && spago sources -p json-codecs-benchmarks | xargs purs compile --codegen corefn,js 'bench/**/*.purs' && purs-backend-es build && OPTIMIZED=1 ./bench-optimized.mjs
scripts.bench: npm run bench-unoptimized && npm run bench-optimized
scripts.snapshots: spago fetch -p json-codecs-snapshots && spago sources -p json-codecs-snapshots | xargs purs compile --codegen corefn,js 'snapshots/**/*.purs' && purs-backend-es build && node -e "import('./output/Test.Snapshot/index.js').then(m => m.main())"
